title: UiTestify — Android Testing Lab
description: The most starred repo on the profile. A comprehensive Android app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose specifically for practising and writing UI test cases using Espresso, Compose Test APIs, and accessibility best practices.
longDescription: Educational Android testing app demonstrating real-world UI testing patterns using modern tooling. Covers Compose UI component demos, form validation, list/grid interactions, edge cases, error states, state management, and accessibility compliance.

title: UiTestify-iOS — XCUITest Practice App
description: A lightweight iOS application designed for learning and practising UI testing with XCUITest. Simulates a real quiz flow with timed interactions, score calculation, and proper accessibility identifiers for test targeting.
longDescription: Educational iOS app that teaches XCUITest automation in a practical, hands-on context. Features Start/Reset/Next/Result interactions, 60% pass threshold logic, and full accessibility identifier coverage — making it ideal for QA engineers learning iOS automation.

title: AppiumTestify — Mobile Automation Framework
description: A structured Appium 2.0 automation framework with Java, Selenium, TestNG, and Maven. Features programmatic Appium server startup and automated emulator launching — eliminating all manual setup steps.
longDescription: Progressive learning framework designed to take developers from beginner to advanced mobile automation. Covers setup, Page Object Model, gestures, BDD/Cucumber, parallel execution, and CI/CD integration across three learning levels.

title: AI Dev Playbook — QA & Developer Edition
description: The complete AI Engineering Playbook for Developers and QA Engineers. Structured guides for collaborating with AI coding assistants — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot — to produce reliable, production-quality output.
longDescription: A resource repository teaching developers to use AI tools effectively. Core philosophy: AI should amplify engineering judgment, not replace it. Includes playbooks for Claude Code, with roadmap covering Gemini, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot, mobile engineering, and testing resources.

title: Free PDF Studio — iOS & macOS
description: Native SwiftUI PDF toolkit for iOS, macOS, and visionOS. Built with Swift 6, PDFKit, and zero third-party dependencies. All processing is on-device — files never leave the user's device.
longDescription: Privacy-first PDF editor built with SwiftUI and Apple-native frameworks. Supports Edit, Merge, Split, and Photos-to-PDF with drag-and-drop reordering. Features dark-mode-first design, gradient mesh backgrounds, spring animations, and strict Swift 6 concurrency.

title: PDF Studio — Android
description: Privacy-first PDF toolkit for Android built with Jetpack Compose and Kotlin. Edit, Merge, Split, Compress, and convert PDFs entirely on-device with Material 3 design. Supports Android 7.0+ (SDK 24).
longDescription: Professional PDF editor using MVVM per-feature architecture and Android native APIs only — zero server-side data transmission. Covers text annotations, pinch-to-zoom editing, multi-file merging with page selection, splitting, image conversion, and compression.

title: Movie App — Jetpack Compose
description: A modern Android movie browser built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3, integrating the TMDb API. Features in-app YouTube trailer playback via ExoPlayer, favourites with local persistence, and full dark mode support.
longDescription: Polished Android app consuming The Movie Database API to browse trending and popular movies. Uses Retrofit2 for networking, Coil for image loading, ExoPlayer for video playback, and SharedPreferences for local favourites storage.

title: Auto-Reel AI — Android Video Creator
description: Native Android app for content creators to produce short-form video reels for Instagram, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and WhatsApp. Built with Kotlin, MVVM, and Material 3 with a roadmap for AI-powered caption generation.
longDescription: Professional reel creator featuring a template library with dynamic layouts, music integration, photo/video sequencing, real-time preview, and multi-platform export optimisation. Built for Android Studio Hedgehog+ with JDK 17.

title: Kroger Search Automation Suite
description: Enterprise automation suite for Kroger's Search platform — covering Predictive Search, Suggestions, Results, Visual Navigation, Sort & Filter, Analytics events, and A/B testing validation across iOS and Android.
longDescription: End-to-end automation for Kroger's highest-traffic feature used by millions of shoppers. Supports A/B experiment validation, analytics tracking verification, feature flag rollouts, and full regression coverage across multiple OS versions.

title: CI/CD Mobile Quality Pipeline
description: End-to-end CI/CD pipeline with Jenkins and GitHub Actions that triggers iOS and Android regression suites on every PR, generates Allure reports, and sends Slack notifications on failures.
longDescription: Built for Kroger Technology. The pipeline runs smoke, regression, and accessibility checks in parallel across iOS and Android. Generates detailed Allure HTML reports and provides PR-level feedback to development teams automatically.
